testo:
■ When you put this card into your mana zone, you may reveal a multicolored card in your hand to your opponent. If you do, untap this card.
■ Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Return one of them to the top of your deck and put the rest in your graveyard.

■ 自分の山札の上から4枚を見る。そのうちの1枚を山札の上に戻し、残りを墓地に置く。
